regions.today: Showery rain this evening in a light to moderate easterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mild and mostly cloudy with showery rain at times. Temperatures will not fall below 13 to 16 degrees in moderate easterly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Wednesday, will be mostly cloudy with rain becoming light and patchy in the morning. Scattered showers in the afternoon and early evening, some heavy with isolated thunderstorms possible. Highest temperatures of 18 to 21 degrees with light to moderate easterly winds.
